(Nea Salamis Famagusta) |nickname = ''Ερυθρόλευκοι'' (Red and Whites) |founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1948|3|7}} |dissolved = |ground = [[Ammochostos Epistrofi Stadium]] |capacity = 5,500 |owntitle = |owner = |chrtitle = Chairman |chairman = Paris Andreou |mgrtitle = Manager |manager = [[Ángel López (football manager)|Angel Lopez]] | league = {{Cypriot football updater|Salamina}} | season = {{Cypriot football updater|Salamina2}} | position = {{Cypriot football updater|Salamina3}} |website = {{URL|http://www.neasalamina.com/}} |pattern_la1 = _nikestripeddivision5wr |pattern_b1 = _nikestripeddivision5wr |pattern_ra1 = _nikestripeddivision5wr |pattern_sh1 = |pattern_so1 = |leftarm1 = FF0000 |body1 = FF0000 |rightarm1 = FF0000 |shorts1 = FF0000 |socks1 = FF0000 |pattern_la2 = |pattern_b2 = _nikepark7b |pattern_ra2 = |pattern_sh2 = |pattern_so2 = |leftarm2 = 000000 |body2 = 000000 |rightarm2 = 000000 |shorts2 = 000000 |socks2 = 000000 |pattern_la3 = |pattern_b3 = |pattern_ra3 = |pattern_sh3 = |pattern_so3 = |leftarm3 = |body3 = |rightarm3 = |shorts3 = |socks3 = }} '''Nea Salamis Famagusta FC''' (alternatively '''Nea Salamina''', {{langx|el|Νέα Σαλαμίνα Αμμοχώστου}}) is a [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] professional [[Association football|football]] [[Sports club|club]] based in [[Ammochostos]] (also known by its [[Romanization of Greek|romanized]] name, [[Famagusta]]). It has been a [[refugee]] club since the 1974 [[Turkish invasion of Cyprus]], when Turkey occupied the northern part of the island. There are also fraternal relations with [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]]. The club is temporarily based in [[Larnaca]] and supported by Meridian.{{Cite web |date=2022-10-02 |title=Meridianbet - Global Betting Partner of 30+ Professional Clubs |work=Meridianbet |url=https://ir.meridianbet.com/2022/10/02/meridianbet-global-betting-partner-of-30-professional-clubs/ |access-date=2024-10-15 |language=en-US}} Nea Salamina's most notable achievements were its victories in the [[Cypriot Cup]] and the [[Cypriot Super Cup]] in 1990. Its highest finish in the [[Cypriot First Division]] is third place. During its first five years (1948–1953), the team participated in the [[Cyprus Amateur Football Federation]] championships. In 1953 the club joined the [[Cyprus Football Association]] (CFA), participating regularly in association championships and cup competitions. It has played in more than 50 [[Cypriot First Division]] seasons, ranking seventh in that [[Cypriot First Division#Participations per club|category]]. The team participated for the first time in European competition in [[1990–91 European Cup Winners' Cup|1990]] at the [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup|European Cup Winners' Cup]], and played in the [[1995 UEFA Intertoto Cup|1995]], [[1997 UEFA Intertoto Cup|1997]] and [[2000 UEFA Intertoto Cup|2000]] [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]]s. The team is part of the [[Nea Salamis Famagusta|Nea Salamina Famagusta]] sports club, which was founded in 1948; the parent club also fields a men's volleyball team. The club is named after the ancient city of Cyprus, [[Salamis, Cyprus|Salamis]] or Salamina, which is located nearby modern [[Famagusta]] ("Nea" means "new" in Greek language)."}}
